templates.examplePlainText:
Reference NITDA/DG/COR/2026/0142 Date 25 September 2026
Dear Executive Secretary,
Please find below the official correspondence of the Agency on the referenced matter.
The Agency writes to formally notify the Commission of the adoption of the National Data Exchange Framework and to request the nomination of two focal persons to coordinate implementation across Nigerian universities.
Action required
Nominate two focal persons and forward their details to the Office of the Director-General.
Kindly respond on or before 9 October 2026.
Please accept the assurances of our highest consideration.
Yours faithfully,
Registry, Office of the Director-General
For: Director-General/CEO

Reference NITDA/DG/RFI/2026/0057 Date 25 September 2026
Dear Executive Secretary,
The Agency is reviewing the referenced correspondence and requests the following information/documentation:
1. A list of ICT infrastructure projects approved in 2025, with their current status.
2. The clearance reference issued by the Agency for each project.
3. The name of the officer responsible for each project.
Reply by 16 October 2026
To enable timely processing, kindly provide the requested information by 16 October 2026.
Thank you for your cooperation.
Yours faithfully,
Registry, Office of the Director-General
For: Director-General/CEO
